Audio

Listening comprehension and speech synthesis are measured separately below. Speech output is transcribed with a local CPU Whisper evaluator; case, punctuation and common digit/number-word spellings are normalized; changed or omitted words fail. This measures intelligibility, not voice naturalness.

How the rating works

Overall = (80% skill quality + 20% speed) × skill coverage. Quality averages the difficulty-weighted success of each measured skill equally. Speed is relative to peers with the same skills and execution location (local or remote). Remote latency includes network/provider time; hardware metadata describes this computer. Coverage is the fraction of declared skills with all scheduled tests attempted. Native skill failures and truncations earn zero; built-in suites use their published EvalScope grading. Unknown skills have zero coverage and prevent overlap recommendations. Task success is the unweighted pass rate over all scheduled tasks. Different skill profiles have different tests, so overall ratings are workload-specific.

Three levels test coding, speech synthesis, text completion, native decisions, visual perception, spoken audio understanding, tool selection/arguments, and reasoning with thinking enabled. Thinking tasks require both a correct answer and nonempty thinking output; this does not independently verify the reasoning trace. Tool calls are inspected, never executed. Audio uses bundled neural English speech with deliberate pacing and pauses and vision uses deterministic image fixtures. Declared capabilities do not guarantee quality. Long-context capacity, open-ended creative quality and real-world generalization are not established.

Advertised context and logical disk size come from Ollama. Shared layers affect reclaimable space. Timings include model loading and may vary with other workloads. The isolated runner stops all loaded Ollama models before each model, checks for other loaded models around every task, and unloads the tested model afterward. Non-Ollama system activity is not controlled. MoE parameter size is the total parameter count; expert counts come from metadata, not an inferred active-parameter estimate. Audio uses the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and its native context defaults; other tasks use the configured context where supported. Repeats of fixed fixtures measure consistency, not independent generalization.
